description_en: Call the ListIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute operation to query backhaul routes for a cloud connector instance after it is attached to a VPC
description_zh: 调用ListIoTCoudConnectorBackhaulRoute接口查询当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-coud-connector-backhaul-route --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCoudConnectorBackhaulRoute

parameters.help_en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

For the first query, leave this parameter empty.

For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the NextToken value from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
